content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

- **No Customer-payable liquidated damages exist.** Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "cancellation charge", "damages", late-payment interest, and minimum/shortfall commitments returned nothing running against IBM.
- **The only penalty mechanics benefit us:** the responsiveness penalty (p0757) and delinquent-shipment profit-rate adjustments (p0749–p0756, p0418–p0419) are payable by MSL — compliant per the detection guidance, and not flagged.
- **Cancellation/termination economics are cost-based, not liquidated:** IBM may cancel Purchase Orders at any time (p0722), with only cost reimbursements under the Price section, and Sections 5.2–5.3 provide purchase prices for completed/partially completed Products and Parts, capped so IBM never pays more for a partially completed Product than a completed one (p0141).
- **Payment terms (Sections 6.1–6.2)** impose no interest or penalty on IBM.
